reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2609.38984v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) leverage pretrained video models to improve generalization in robot control by jointly predicting future visual states and actions. reported_papers.title: VITA: Vision-to-Action Flow Matching Policy
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2507.13231v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Conventional flow matching and diffusion-based policies sample via iterative denoising from standard noise distributions (e.g., Gaussian), and require conditioning modules to repeatedly incorporate visual information during the generative process, incurring substantial time and memory overhead. reported_papers.title: Neural Fidelity Calibration for Informative Sim-to-Real Adaptation
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2504.08604v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning can seamlessly transfer agile locomotion and navigation skills from the simulator to real world. reported_papers.title: Learning World Models through Contrastive Identification of Actions
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2611.32776v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Latent world models enable goal-directed planning from offline visual data, but prediction alone does not specify which action-related distinctions their representations should preserve. reported_papers.title: $\varepsilon$-WM: Error-Driven Dynamics Adaptation across Fast--Slow Timescales for World Modeling
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2611.15215v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A core challenge for world models is adapting to sudden, persistent, yet initially unknown changes in robot dynamics. reported_papers.title: RAN-JEPA: An Action-Conditioned World Model for Energy-efficient Mobile Network Control
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2610.17584v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Operational mobile networks are rich in observations but poor in interventions: they continuously generate large volumes of passive telemetry, while controlled action--response trajectories remain comparatively scarce and costly to collect. reported_papers.title: Not all world models can doubt: how training objective and architecture shape epistemic uncertainty in JEPA and RSSM world models
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2611.34830v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: World models predict how an environment responds to actions, so that candidate actions can be evaluated before execution. reported_papers.title: Do We Still Need Reinforcement Learning When We Can Read the World Model?
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2611.34656v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reinforcement learning has achieved remarkable success in sequential decision-making, but learning effective policies often requires substantial interaction experience. reported_papers.title: Long-Horizon Planning with Latent World Models via Graph Anchors
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2611.34509v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Latent world models plan in a compact latent space by predicting the outcomes of actions. reported_papers.title: Most of the Way There: Turning a Strong Video Prior into an Action-Conditioned World Model
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2611.34435v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modern video generators excel at producing visually plausible futures guided by text and image prompts. reported_papers.title: Temporal Selective Exploration for Reinforcement Learning-Guided Continuous-Discrete Flow Matching in 3D Molecular Design
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2611.33417v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Flow matching has shown strong potential in generative tasks, while its optimization via Reinforcement Learning (RL) remains underexplored, especially in continuous-discrete mixed settings. reported_papers.title: Improving Building Energy Efficiency with an Indoor Environmental World Model and Counterfactual Adaptive Learning
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2611.33764v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optimizing indoor climate systems plays a critical role in achieving the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals 11 and 13. reported_papers.title: Beyond the Happy Path: Generalizing Robot World Models from Simulated Failures
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: Robot world models are increasingly used to evaluate and plan policies, yet robot training data are dominated by successful demonstrations. Off the happy path, when a grasp is misaligned or mistimed and the object is pushed, tilted, or slips, their predictions break down. reported_papers.reason: 指出在五个预训练策略上，世界模型在抓取偏移、推动、滑落等失败场景下预测全面失效，并用仿真失败数据增强来泛化；提醒 WAM 训练数据偏乐观的问题，方法尚属修补。

reported_papers.title: WorldPhy: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Physical Plausibility of World Models in Robotics
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: World models are increasingly used in robotics to improve the performance of embodied models. reported_papers.title: What a Drop Reveals: Sim-to-Real Material Estimation for Deformable Objects from Video
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: How an object deforms when it hits the ground reveals what it is made of. reported_papers.title: Learning a Whole-Body Pivot-Walking Gait for Heavy-Box Transport with a Humanoid
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: Through pivot walking, humans can transport objects that are too heavy to lift. reported_papers.title: EgoMyo: Physical Hand State Estimation from Egocentric Video and Wrist Electromyography
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: Physical hand interaction depends on configuration, contact, and force, yet nearly identical appearances can conceal different contact states and exerted forces. reported_papers.title: RoboAda: Adapting Frozen Robot Policies at Test Time to Physics They Cannot See
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2611.30209v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Pretrained robot policies decide what to do from camera images, yet some of the physics that decides whether their plans succeed is not visible. reported_papers.title: RoboThink: Let the Agent Think, Let the Policy Act
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2611.30111v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Robot policies act in real time but fail without knowing why, whereas a reasoning agent that watches the robot can often tell what went wrong. reported_papers.title: Entangle: Scaling Human-Video In-Context World-Action Models across Unseen Tasks and Contexts
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2611.28732v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables foundation models to perform unseen tasks from context without parameter updates. reported_papers.title: NSFL: A Post-Training Neuro-Symbolic Fuzzy Logic Framework for Boolean Operators in Neural Embeddings
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2604.10604v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Standard dense retrievers have no native mechanism for multi-atom logical constraints. reported_papers.title: PLAICraft: Large-Scale Time-Aligned Vision-Speech-Action Dataset for Embodied AI
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2505.12707v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Advances in deep generative modeling have made it increasingly plausible to train human-level embodied agents. reported_papers.title: EffectWAM: Learning Action-Grounded Effects for Robot Manipulation

reported_papers.title: RePace: Reasoning about Demonstration Speedup for Faster Vision-Language-Action Policies
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2611.34864v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Since vision-language-action (VLA) policies can inherit the slow pace of human demonstrations, accelerating these demonstrations before fine-tuning can lead to faster VLA policies without an additional speed-selection module at deployment. reported_papers.title: Towards 360$^\circ$ Embodied UAV Tracking Without Turning

reported_papers.title: A Failure-Driven Data Flywheel for Post-Training Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2611.34698v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models rarely satisfy all behavioral requirements of a new platform, and teams without a large deployed fleet lack the data to address the resulting failures. reported_papers.title: Keep or Roll Back? Out-of-Loop Judges for Self-Improving VLA and End-to-End Embodied Policies

reported_papers.title: WhatIf: Counterfactual World Models over Action-Grounded Causal Graphs for Robotic Manipulation
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2611.33745v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: World models predict what happens under an action, but choosing between actions requires comparing their outcomes in the same physical situation. reported_papers.title: Constraint-Aware Test-Time Scoring for LLM and VLM Candidate Selection
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2611.33161v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When an LLM or VLM produces several candidate answers, picking the best one usually relies on the model's own confidence, a learned judge model, or a domain check. reported_papers.title: FlipVLA: Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language-Action(VLA) Models Only Through Bit Flips
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: Vision-language-action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions in real-world environments, making malicious model tampering a potential threat to physical safety. reported_papers.title: DriftWAM: Faster World-Action Models via Action-Aware Video Drifting
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: World-action models (WAMs) unify future video prediction and action generation for robotic control, but their reliance on iterative denoising incurs substantial inference costs. reported_papers.title: RoboEvo$^2$: Recursive Robot Self-Improvement via Harness-Policy Co-Evolution
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2611.34675v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Robots should adapt to unfamiliar environments and acquire new skills through interaction, then execute those skills efficiently with practice. reported_papers.title: DemoFoundry: Toward Scalable Photorealistic Robot Data with Coding Agents and Generative Rendering
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2611.34671v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scaling robot learning requires demonstrations that combine realistic visual observations with reliable action supervision. reported_papers.title: $\mu$MPC: Microsecond-Scale Nonlinear and World Model Control from Edge to GPU via Koopman-Linearized Precompilation

reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2512.04308v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Safe task-level manipulation requires a planner to recognize hazards, select appropriate mitigation actions, and satisfy their execution prerequisites without abandoning the original goal. reported_papers.title: DexCanvas: Bridging Human Demonstrations and Robot Learning for Dexterous Manipulation
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2510.15786v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A dexterous hand succeeds or fails through contact, yet every scalable record of human manipulation (video, vision-based hand tracking, motion capture) observes how the hand moves and misses how it pushes. reported_papers.title: DRAP: Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity for Continual Learning in Physical AI

reported_papers.title: Aero-VPA: Few-Step Flow-Matching Control over Non-Reconstructive JEPA Latents for Agile Flight on Edge Hardware

reported_papers.title: Say the Same, Act Differently: Diagnosing and Steering Text-Action Divergence in Reasoning VLAs
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2611.04166v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models pair physical control with natural-language rationales that supervisors can read to monitor embodied safety. reported_papers.title: PolicyIK: High-Precision Inverse Kinematics for Robot Arms with Reinforcement Learning

reported_papers.title: Should the Action Expert Train the VLM? Action-Token Supervision and Gradient Routing in Mixture-of-Transformer VLAs

reported_papers.title: LoopQ: Fair, Closed-Loop Evaluation of Quantized Vision-Language-Action Models

reported_papers.title: RAFT: Reasoning-Aligned Fine-Tuning Improves Robustness of VLA Post-Training

reported_papers.title: Revisiting Distribution Matching for State-to-Vision Policy Distillation in Laparoscopic Robotic Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 在腔镜手术机器人中把基于特权状态的 RL 策略蒸馏为纯视觉策略，重新审视分布匹配目标的作用；属手术机器人操作，与通用 VLA 主线无直接衔接。

reported_papers.title: IORA: Irregular Object Immobilization under Restricted Actuation
reported_papers.reason: 面向低自由度、受限驱动的手在扰动下稳定固定不规则物体，通过接触拓扑与掌面配置优化合成抓取；纯抓取规划工作，不含学习型 VLA 环节。

reported_papers.title: TEAR: Task-Evidence Authority Routing for Robotic Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 让机器人在线决定控制权归谁：遥操作、脚本控制器还是学习策略，提出基于任务证据的路由机制；属部署层仲裁，与 VLA 架构/训练关联有限。

reported_papers.title: When One Step Is Enough: An Empirical Study of Euler Integration in Flow-Matching Policies
reported_papers.reason: 系统研究 flow-matching 策略（π0 类）能否用单步 Euler 采样替代多步 ODE 求解，给出精度—延迟权衡的经验结论，可直接用于压缩 VLA 推理耗时。

reported_papers.title: Co^2Gen: Collaboratively Generating Task Plans for Decentralized Multi-Robot and Human Collaboration
reported_papers.reason: 针对 VLA 模型与其他机器人/人类协作能力不足的问题，提出去中心化的协作任务规划生成方法；摘要仅有问题动机与框架描述，无量化结果，暂作了解。

reported_papers.title: Tactile-Based Robotic Manipulation: From Mechanics-Driven to Data-Driven Perspectives
reported_papers.reason: Wenzhen Yuan 团队的触觉操作综述，梳理从力学建模到数据驱动（学习型触觉表征与策略）的范式转变，是触觉 VLA 方向的系统性背景参考，重要但不紧急。

reported_papers.title: From Association to Decision Value: Testing Paired Instruction Dependence for VLA Corpus Selection
reported_papers.reason: 把机器人示教数据集的挑选建模为排序问题，提出"配对指令依赖性"诊断，检验候选语料能否预测下游策略优劣而非只与平均性能相关；属数据筛选评估工具，未给出新策略训练结果。

reported_papers.title: $\mu_0$: A Scalable 3D Interaction-Trace World Model
reported_papers.reason: 构建以 3D 交互痕迹而非像素外观为核心的世界模型，避免把容量浪费在稠密外观重建上，从而摆脱对本体相关动作标签的依赖。对可扩展世界模型预训练有参考价值，非 VLA 策略架构。

reported_papers.title: Multi-Resolution Tactile Imitation Learning for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 研究异构多分辨率触觉传感器（不同频率/空间精度）如何融合用于接触丰富操作模仿学习，给出多传感器触觉融合的具体做法与任务收益。做触觉 VLA 时可直接借鉴其融合与表征方案。

reported_papers.title: Feedback World Model Enables Precise Guidance of Diffusion Policy
reported_papers.reason: 指出世界模型在分布外状态预测不可靠，引入反馈式世界模型来修正预测并指导扩散策略。对世界模型 + 扩散策略的组合有改进意义，但非 VLA 层面贡献。

reported_papers.title: WARPED: Wrist-Aligned Rendering for Robot Policy Learning from Egocentric Human Demonstrations
reported_papers.reason: 通过腕部对齐渲染把第一视角人类演示转成机器人可用的视动策略训练数据，缓解人类-机器人视角与本体差异。属人类视频迁移数据管线工作，与已有重投影方法思路相近。

reported_papers.title: Safe-Night VLA: Seeing the Unseen via Thermal-Perceptive Vision-Language-Action Models for Safety-Critical Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 给 VLA 引入热成像模态，解决 RGB 无法感知温度/热源的安全关键操作问题，并补上端到端生成策略缺失的可解释性。属新感知模态扩展，评测规模与泛化性待确认。

reported_papers.title: AFFORD2ACT: How Far Can Sparse Keypoints Go for Robot Manipulation?
reported_papers.reason: 系统探究稀疏关键点替代稠密全分辨率视觉特征做操作策略的极限，回答“到底需要多少视觉信息”。对轻量化视觉表征设计有参考意义，但非 VLA 架构创新。

reported_papers.title: AgiBot World Colosseo: A Large-scale Manipulation Platform for Scalable and Intelligent Embodied Systems
reported_papers.reason: AgiBot World 数据集/平台更新版：百万级轨迹、217 任务、五类部署场景，是当前最大规模真机操作数据资源之一。数据集重要但非新方法，团队应追踪其数据协议与模型释放情况。

reported_papers.title: Agentic World Action Models
reported_papers.reason: 把代码式规划与可复用技能库接入世界动作模型，补上 WAM 缺失的组合式技能复用机制。思路是 world model + agentic 的拼接，摘要未见量化验证其相对纯 WAM 的收益。

reported_papers.title: Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation Learns In-Context Exploration
reported_papers.reason: 在部分可观测序列决策中，用非对称 on-policy 蒸馏让学生策略获得“先探明隐藏信息再行动”的上下文探索行为，替代 tabula rasa 在线 RL。方法偏通用决策理论，未见机器人操作实验。

reported_papers.title: AtomicRL: Atomic Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 在 VLA 模仿学习之上引入原子技能级 RL 精调，缓解 IL 难以掌握长程复杂技能的问题。RL 精调 VLA 路线已有较多同类工作，需看具体技能分解与稀疏奖励设计是否带来实质增益。

reported_papers.title: From Reasoning to Action: Benchmarking Frontier AI Models on LIBERO-10 Robot Manipulation Tasks
reported_papers.reason: 系统评测前沿通用大模型在 LIBERO-10 长程操作上的直接可用性，考察视觉理解/推理能力能否零样本转化为动作。属评测类工作，可作为基线参考但不提供新方法。

reported_papers.title: SP-HLM: Sparse-Pose-Driven Motion Generation and Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 用稀疏位姿作为高层任务策略与全身控制之间的统一接口，缓解人形移动操作中意图与全身协调共用单一动作表示的负担。属人形全身控制方向，非 VLA 架构。

reported_papers.title: Post-hoc Epistemic Uncertainty for Vision-Language-Action Policies
reported_papers.reason: 用事后认知不确定性（集成分歧等）让 VLA 识别训练知识盲区，从而主动请求演示或人工协助。对部署期数据采集策略有实用价值，但本身不改变策略能力。

reported_papers.title: Reconstruction-Augmented Visuomotor Pre-Training of 3D-Grounded Bimanual Dexterity from RGB-Only Human Videos
reported_papers.reason: 只用 RGB 人类视频，通过重建增强把人类行为与其空间上下文一起预训练成 3D 接地的双臂灵巧视动策略，摆脱深度传感与机器人硬件依赖。为“人类视频→双臂灵巧”预训练范式提供了可复制流程。

reported_papers.title: CausGround: Causal Interaction Grounding for Adaptive Embodied Planning
reported_papers.reason: 为 MLLM 规划器补上动作可执行前提与世界状态变化的因果接地，减少不可执行计划。属高层规划增强，未涉及动作空间生成。

reported_papers.title: FlowVLA: Learning Flow-Aware Physical Completion for Quantitative Robotic Pouring
reported_papers.reason: 针对倒水过程中图像与位姿几乎不变、转移质量却持续累积的“视觉静默”问题，把流量感知的物理完成度从动作生成中解耦出来，用于判断何时停止。定量倒水场景较窄，但可借鉴其“任务进度状态”建模思路。

reported_papers.title: Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI
reported_papers.reason: 讨论把数字智能体的“自我改写代码 + 可执行测试校验”闭环迁移到物理 AI，让系统改进自身的改进流程。属观点/框架层面，摘要未给出具体算法与量化结果。

reported_papers.title: From VLM Planners to Robotic Agents: Self-Evolving Harnesses for History-Dependent Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 用自演化的 agent harness 包裹 VLA，处理长程任务中的非马尔可夫依赖，把历史相关信息显式维护在策略外。是 agentic 控制路线的一种实现，细节与增益待正文确认。

reported_papers.title: Plan First, Act Later: Streaming Reasoning for Executable Memory in Robot Control
reported_papers.reason: 把长程记忆从执行时的检索-推理改造为“先规划、后执行”的流式推理记忆，缓解超出观测窗口的任务信息遗忘。属长程操作记忆机制，尚未与 VLA 主干联调验证。

reported_papers.title: Relational Geometry Forcing for World Action Models
reported_papers.reason: 指出世界动作模型的视频/动作目标缺少显式 3D 几何约束，提出关系几何强制项来提升精确操作下的空间一致性。对 WAM 训练目标设计有启发，但需看实际精度收益。

reported_papers.title: Training in Deployment: Human-in-the-loop Online Post-Training for Robot Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 针对离线遥操作数据覆盖不到接触丰富与恢复状态的问题，提出部署期在线 HIL 后训练，让机器人在真实任务执行中持续吸收人类干预。可与 SimPT 互补，构成从仿真到在线的 VLA 后训练路线。

reported_papers.title: DepState-JEPA: Learning Depth-Grounded State Representation for Visual Perception and Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 用深度对齐的预测式表征把场景几何与动作引起的状态变化绑定起来，替代纯 RGB 预测表征。属于操作表征学习方向，尚不清楚能否直接接入现有 VLA 主干。

reported_papers.title: NavBind: Diagnosing Instruction-Action Binding at Route Forks in Navigation VLAs
reported_papers.reason: 指出导航 VLA 的到达成功率掩盖了指令-动作绑定失败，并用岔路口的诊断基准分离“真听懂指令”与“碰巧到达”。对导航 VLA 评测设计有参考价值，但不涉及操作。

reported_papers.title: SimPT: An Automated Simulation Framework for Intervention-Based VLA Post-Training
reported_papers.reason: 把人工干预式 VLA 后训练搬到仿真中自动化，用仿真替代昂贵真机 HIL 修正与重复评估，让后训练算法可以大规模试错。无真机也能复现，适合本周搭 post-training baseline。

reported_papers.title: Learning to Absorb Corrections: Critic-Weighted Residual Flow for Vision-Based Insertion
reported_papers.reason: 将 ACT 与条件残差流耦合，用 critic 加权在线吸收人类修正以提升视觉插孔的装配对齐精度；思路适用于精密插入，但仅针对单一任务族，通用性未验证。

reported_papers.title: GGraph: A GPU-Accelerated Library for Graph-Based Robot Deployment and Learning
reported_papers.reason: 面向移动机器人建图/规划的空间图表示 GPU 加速库，与操作策略和 VLA 建模无关。

reported_papers.title: Real2Sem2Real: 3D Semantic Augmentations for Robot Learning from a Single Human RGB Demonstration
reported_papers.reason: 仅用单条人类 RGB 视频做 real→semantic→real 增强来扩充机器人演示数据，省去深度传感与 2D 叠加流程；思路对数据增广有用，但缺少策略层面的量化对比。

reported_papers.title: T-WLA: Bridging Slow Vision and Fast Touch
reported_papers.reason: 针对接触状态变化快于视觉策略更新频率的问题，提出视觉慢环 + 触觉快环的双速率 VLA 结构，用触觉在线修正进行中的动作而非重算整段规划。可直接复用到高频触觉反馈的接触丰富操作策略设计。

reported_papers.title: World2HOSI: A Multi-Expert Harness for Long-Horizon Human-Object-Scene Interaction Generation
reported_papers.reason: 面向动画/游戏的长程人-物-场景交互动作生成框架，无机器人本体与操作实验，也不产出可直接用于策略学习的机器人数据。

reported_papers.title: Structural bias enables reliable sim-to-real transfer in reinforcement learning for robot swarms
reported_papers.reason: Science Robotics 的群体机器人 sim-to-real RL 工作，研究的是集群结构偏置而非操作策略学习，无视觉-语言-动作建模，与 VLA 无实质交集。

reported_papers.title: TrajWAM: An Efficient Trajectory-Guided World Action Model for Dynamic Robotic Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 用轨迹引导的世界-动作模型预测目标未来运动并据此快速重规划，避免执行过时动作。属动态操作世界模型，摘要未给与 VLA/操作基准的定量对比。

reported_papers.title: Learning from Fleet Experience: A Collective Learning Paradigm for Robots
reported_papers.reason: 提出机群集体学习范式，让部署中的机器人用自身执行经验互相提升策略可靠性，减少人工纠正与监控。偏数据飞轮/流程框架，摘要缺具体策略级方法与量化对比。

reported_papers.title: SWAP: Test-Time Steerable Humanoid Whole-Body Collision Avoidance
reported_papers.reason: 在保持平衡的前提下让全身协调穿越狭窄拥挤空间，并支持测试时调节避障倾向。属人形全身控制与安全，不涉及操作或 VLA。

reported_papers.title: ReDOA: Real-World Distillation via Observation Alignment for Image-Based Manipulation Policy Learning
reported_papers.reason: 通过观测对齐把仿真训练的视觉操作策略蒸馏到真实域，降低真机示教成本。属 sim-to-real 视觉策略学习，非语言条件 VLA，但观测对齐技巧可借鉴。

reported_papers.title: Vector-Quantized World Model: Latent Feedback Motion Planning for Robot Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 用向量量化世界模型提供离散隐空间反馈，缓解长程操作中预测误差累积与低层控制器追不上隐规划的问题。世界模型规划方向值得了解，但摘要未给标准 benchmark 对比。

reported_papers.title: AQUAACT: A Joystick-Level Underwater Teleoperation Dataset and Closed-Loop Benchmark
reported_papers.reason: 发布摇杆级水下机器人遥操作数据集与闭环基准，任务是巡检/作业类航行控制。与桌面操作 VLA 的数据结构和动作空间差异大，迁移价值有限。

reported_papers.title: BiDex-100: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Across 100+ Simulation Tasks
reported_papers.reason: 提出覆盖 100+ 任务的双臂灵巧手操作基准，填补灵巧操作评测缺失。基准类工作，对双臂方向有参考价值但非紧急方法进展。

reported_papers.title: T(R,O) Grasp++: Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasping in Cluttered Environments at Scale
reported_papers.reason: 构建大规模仿真灵巧抓取数据集与跨本体抓取模型，在杂乱场景下解决高维手-环境约束协调。属抓取合成与数据生成，不涉及 VLA 策略训练。

reported_papers.title: AeroDASH: Asynchronous Vision-Language-Action Control for Continuous UAV Flight
reported_papers.reason: 针对无人机连续飞行，用异步 VLA 推理缓解板载时延与机体运动错配的问题。时延补偿思路可迁移到操作 VLA，但任务本体是飞行控制而非物体操作。

reported_papers.title: Energy-Score Stabilized Attentive Mixture-Density Policy: A Lightweight Approach to Multimodal Robot Motion
reported_papers.reason: 用注意力混合密度网络加能量分数稳定训练，在低推理成本下建模多模态动作分布。属动作头/模仿学习细节改进，缺真实机器人规模验证与 VLA 结合。

reported_papers.title: Vision as Proprioception: Estimating Humanoid Robot Pose from Video
reported_papers.reason: 从外部视频估计人形机器人本体位姿与内部状态，作为无法读取本体信息时的替代感知。属状态估计方向，与操作策略学习无直接接口。

reported_papers.title: Compile Once, Run Cheap: Frozen, Portable Skills for Embodied Agents, and What Recursive Self-Improvement Adds
reported_papers.reason: 让强通用模型只在离线阶段把任务编译成可复用技能库，之后廉价执行，并量化递归自我改进带来的增益。属具身 agent 技能复用思路，摘要未给策略层面的 VLA 方法细节。

reported_papers.title: Scalable, Intuitive, Mixed Reality-Based Semi-Autonomous Robotic Telemanipulation for the Execution of a Fine-Grained Bimanual Task
reported_papers.reason: 混合现实半自主遥操作系统用于精细双臂任务，重点是低成本、可扩展地采集高质量示教数据。可作双臂数据采集工具链的工程参考，无策略层面新方法。

reported_papers.title: Dream What I Can: Sparse Visual Planning for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 用视频模型做稀疏视觉规划：高层只产出少量可执行子目标，低层策略负责落地，避免“看起来合理但执行不了”的视觉未来。可复用点：稀疏子目标筛选+可执行性 grounding 能直接嵌进现有视频世界模型策略。

reported_papers.title: DiPLO: Self-distilled Diffusion Planning for Loco-manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 用自蒸馏的扩散规划协调人形机器人行走、平衡与物体交互，减少对大量示教或从零 RL 的依赖。属人形全身 loco-manipulation 方法，非语言条件 VLA。

reported_papers.title: SARAM: Sparse Adapter Allocation with Reuse and Merging for Lifelong Robot Learning
reported_papers.reason: 在 VLA 主干上做持续学习：稀疏分配适配器并用复用/合并抑制适配器数量膨胀与灾难遗忘。属终身学习适配器管理，方法可借鉴但优先级低于当前主线。

reported_papers.title: EndoVLA-OOV: Language-Conditioned Out-of-View Target Acquisition in Robotic Endoscopy
reported_papers.reason: 面向胃镜“先扫查再回看”流程的视野外目标再定位，属医疗机器人专用任务与解剖场景，与通用操作 VLA 研究缺乏可比实验与复用路径。

reported_papers.title: Relational Spatial Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_papers.reason: 指出把 VLA 表征直接对齐预训练 3D 模型的做法不足，改为用物体间关系式空间对齐来注入空间理解。可复用点：该对齐目标能作为辅助损失接入现有 VLA 训练，改善方位/放置类指令。

reported_papers.title: Refuse the Harm, Complete the Task via Graph-of-Rules Planning for LLM-Enabled Robots
reported_papers.reason: 用规则图在推理期同时拒绝越狱诱导的危险指令并完成任务规划。属具身安全与 LLM 高层规划方向，与 VLA 动作模型本身关联有限。

reported_papers.title: LIBERO-Pro2.0: A Benchmark for Evaluating the Robustness of Embodied Foundation Models
reported_papers.reason: 对 LIBERO 施加系统性扰动，检验具身基础模型是真正鲁棒还是只吃透了基准规律。诊断/基准类，适合作为鲁棒性自检工具。

reported_papers.title: LIBERO-Dynamic: Benchmarking Robotic Manipulation in Dynamic Environments
reported_papers.reason: 把 LIBERO 的目标物体改为运动中，专门暴露策略推理耗时与观测过时带来的问题，评测动态目标下的操作表现。基准类工作，可用于诊断推理时延影响。

reported_papers.title: Retrieval-triggered Action Projection Adjustment for Frozen VLA Policies: An Empirical Study and Failure Analysis
reported_papers.reason: 给冻结的 OpenVLA 外挂一层检索触发式动作投影校正：遇到曾失败的场景就检索并调整动作投影，不更新权重，并附失败模式分析。可复用点：部署后无训练纠错的最小改动方案。

reported_papers.title: ContactBench 1.0: A Benchmark for Everyday Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 面向日常接触丰富操作的系统性基准，覆盖多样接触行为并统一跨实验室复现协议，补上接触类任务评测的缺口。基准类工作，重要但不紧急。

reported_papers.title: GazeAct: A Human-Gaze-Annotated Manipulation Dataset for Attention-Regularized Policies
reported_papers.reason: 发布带人类注视标注的操作数据集，并用注视注意力正则约束 VLA 把指令落到正确物体、接触点与目标位置。数据集类贡献，可作 grounding 辅助监督与数据增广来源。

reported_papers.title: Touch Where It Matters: Learning Local Tactile Policies for Fine-Grained Gripper Control
reported_papers.reason: 在视觉模仿策略之上叠加局部触觉反馈策略，做超出“开/合”的细粒度夹爪调节，处理接触丰富操作。可复用点：这种“全局视觉规划+局部触觉修正”的分层结构可直接接到 ACT/DP 类策略上。

reported_papers.title: ESCAPE: Egocentric Sensing for Collision Avoidance and Policy Execution
reported_papers.reason: 改用机载自视角感知替代外置相机完成避障与策略执行，规避遮挡、杂乱与标定问题。偏视觉运动策略与运动规划的鲁棒性改进，无语言条件 VLA 内容。

reported_papers.title: AutoPruner: Agentic Depth Pruning for Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_papers.reason: 对 VLA 做深度层剪枝，用 agent 联合决定剪哪些层与如何恢复性能，输出可直接部署的压缩配置。可复用点：给 OpenVLA 类模型提供“自动搜索剪枝+恢复微调”的部署流水线。

reported_papers.title: DUET: Decoupled Upper- and Lower-Body Execution for Task-Agnostic Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 把人形机器人上身操作与下身平衡控制解耦，替换操作策略时无需重训平衡控制器，两套控制器独立运行与切换。属于人形 loco-manipulation 系统工程，未涉及语言条件策略或 VLA 训练。

reported_papers.title: EDAR: Learning Environment-Dependent Action Representations for Robotic Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 指出仅编码动作流结构不足，改为学习依赖环境观测的动作表征，以抑制原始控制轨迹的噪声与冗余。

reported_papers.title: NativeMEM: Native Memory Compression for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 把长程视觉历史压缩进 VLA 内部而非依赖外部记忆管理，在高频更新下兼顾记忆跨度与推理效率。

reported_papers.title: WireCraft: A Simulation Benchmark for Industrial DLO Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 面向上业线缆等可变形线性物体的仿真 benchmark，处理无限维构型与连续形变下的操作评测，填补 DLO 操作缺乏统一评测的空白。

reported_papers.title: Learning What to Say to Your VLA: Mostly Harmless Vision Language Action Model Steering
reported_papers.reason: 研究语义相近指令引发 VLA 行为剧变的问题，学习如何生成/选择稳健的语言指令来引导策略；语言接口鲁棒性方向。

reported_papers.title: OxyGen: Unified KV Cache Management for VLA Inference under Multi-Task Parallelism
reported_papers.reason: 针对 MoT 类 VLA 多任务并行（操作/对话/记忆构建）场景统一管理 KV cache，缓解共享观测下的显存与延迟冲突；属部署侧系统优化。

reported_papers.title: Confidence Calibration in Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_papers.reason: 首个系统研究 VLA 置信度校准的工作，让策略能可靠量化任务成功概率，支撑下游可信决策与失败检测。

reported_papers.title: Not All Actions Contribute Equally: Learning Precise Progress Estimation from Imprecise Demonstrations
reported_papers.reason: 针对进度估计器对专家数据依赖强、动作等权聚合的问题，从非精确演示中学细粒度任务进度，为操作 RL 提供更稠密的奖励信号。

reported_papers.title: Enhancing Visual Task-Redirection Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models via Closed-Loop Optimization
reported_papers.reason: 改用闭环优化生成视觉扰动，提升任务重定向攻击在 VLA 上的有效性，暴露语言-视觉控制链路的安全弱点；属安全性分析。

reported_papers.title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
reported_papers.reason: 用极薄封装让 VLM 编码 agent 直接控制机器人，系统探究代码 agent 在操作基准上能走多远、在哪里失效；agentic 控制方向参考。

reported_papers.title: AWAM: Active Trajectory-Conditioned View Imagination for Robust Robot Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 以候选轨迹为条件主动想象未来视角，提升开放世界遮挡与分布外条件下的操作鲁棒性；世界模型+主动感知的组合探索。

reported_papers.title: Look Before You Act: Bridging Active Perception and Vision-Language-Action Models via Observation-Aligned Data Adaptation
reported_papers.reason: 用观测对齐的数据适配把主动相机运动接入 VLA，解决主动视角造成初始观测分布偏移、与操作阶段不匹配的问题。

reported_papers.title: Beyond Success Rate: Interventional Evaluation of Memory in Vision-Language-Action Systems
reported_papers.reason: 用干预式评测检验 VLA 的记忆是否真被使用，指出成功率消融会同时改变信息与计算、掩盖互补增益；做记忆机制时值得引用的评测方法论。

reported_papers.title: LAW: Unifying Language, Action, and World Modeling for Agentic Physical Intelligence
reported_papers.reason: 闭环 VLM 同时做语言子任务推理、动作生成与未来状态预测，用于长程操作的进度判断与动作选择；标题中的 physical intelligence 为术语非公司名。

reported_papers.title: From Sliding Windows to Self-evolving Lifelong Memory: A Dual-perspective Survey of Memory Paradigms for Long-Horizon Robotics VLA Models
reported_papers.reason: 综述长程 VLA 的记忆范式，从滑动窗口到自演化终身记忆，梳理时序上下文受限这一核心瓶颈的现有解法，适合做方向入门与选型。

reported_papers.title: CoEvolve: Self-Evolving Code Policies from Skills to Strategies for Humanoid Robots
reported_papers.reason: 在类人机器人上让 VLM 驱动代码策略从底层技能自演化到高层策略，配合 VLA/WAM 完成单机难以胜任的组合任务；偏 agentic 代码生成路线。

reported_papers.title: NestedVLA: Learning to Consolidate and Generate Skills for Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_papers.reason: 用嵌套式技能巩固+生成缓解跨平台碎片化数据的多任务训练冲突，让 VLA 能累积异构任务技能；偏训练策略层面改进。

reported_papers.title: ORD-WM: Learning Object-Centric Rigid Dynamics for 3D World Modeling in Robotic Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 构建以物体为中心的 3D 世界模型，显式施加刚体运动约束来修正图像/稠密 3D 世界模型中缺失的刚性先验；世界模型方向可参考。

reported_papers.title: GRASP: Global-Local Representation Alignment and Spatial-Physical Grounding for Bimanual Robotic Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 针对直接回归关节空间的双臂 VLA，指出关节损失与任务成功不对齐，用全局-局部表征对齐与空间-物理 grounding 修正训练目标。

reported_papers.title: Unifying Embodied Foundation Models via a Model-to-Policy Formulation
reported_papers.reason: 提出 model-to-policy 形式化，试图统一 VLA 与 world-action model 的架构与输出表示差异；偏概念性统一框架，具体实证有限。

reported_papers.title: VLA-Fabric: Learning Interaction for Composable Multi-Arm VLA Agents
reported_papers.reason: 把多机械臂协调组织为可组合的交互技能，构建多臂 VLA 系统以应对单臂难以完成的任务；双臂/多臂协作方向值得对照阅读。

reported_papers.title: GR-VIP: Geometric representation conditioning for precise visuomotor policy
reported_papers.reason: 用几何表征条件化视觉运动策略，提升移动机器人终点位置与朝向对齐精度及未见目标泛化，属移动机器人控制而非 VLA 架构贡献。

reported_papers.title: MambaAct: Efficient Mamba Action Experts for Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_papers.reason: 用 Mamba 结构替换 flow-matching VLA（π0 类）的去噪动作专家，显著压低推理开销以满足实时控制；可作为 action head 直接替换复用。

reported_papers.title: Ego2Contact: Predicting Touch from Egocentric Human Video for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 从第一视角人类视频预测接触位置与交互力，绕开触觉硬件与平台专属采集，为接触密集操作提供可扩展的触觉监督来源，触觉 VLA 可直接用作数据增强。

reported_papers.title: Pedicel-Targeted Strawberry Harvesting via Imitation Learning on a Low-Cost Teleoperated Robotic Arm
reported_papers.reason: 低成本遥操作臂+模仿学习实现 1.3-3mm 草莓果柄的精准抓取与力控分离，属特定农业场景应用，方法层面无通用迁移价值。

reported_papers.title: Embodiment-Classifier Guidance: Transferring Frozen VLAs Across Robot Dynamics without Demonstrations
reported_papers.reason: 用轻量 embodiment 分类器引导冻结的 π0 flow policy，在无新演示、不更新参数的情况下迁移到新机器人动力学；是跨本体部署可即插即用的低成本方案。

reported_papers.title: When Plans Change, Remember: Replanning-Guided Visual Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_papers.reason: 提出重规划引导的视觉记忆选择机制，让长程多阶段 VLA 只保留与当前子目标相关的历史观测，避免全历史存储的冗余开销。

reported_papers.title: Scaling Online Exploration for Robot Agents
reported_papers.reason: 主张用规模化在线探索突破模仿数据分布限制，减少新本体/新任务对专用遥操作语料的依赖；摘要未给出具体算法与 VLA 结合细节。

reported_papers.title: Has GPT-6-Astra Achieved Embodied Intelligence?
reported_papers.reason: 对 GPT-6-Astra 的机器人操作与导航能力做测评与讨论，质疑专用模型的传统范式；属闭源模型能力报告，无新方法与可复现实验。

reported_papers.title: DexMimic: A Generalist Dexterous Hand-Object Tracking Policy via Value-Guided Reset Allocation
reported_papers.reason: 从人类手-物交互数据训练通用灵巧跟踪策略，用值函数引导 reset 分配以提升物理仿真中的课程式学习效率。面向动作重定向与跟踪而非视觉-语言条件策略，可作为灵巧 VLA 的低层动作先验。

reported_papers.title: World Modeling through Spectral Alignment
reported_papers.reason: 从谱表示学习角度提出 SpecWM，显式指定观测之间应保持的关系，从而控制 JEPA 世界模型保留哪些信息。提供了「告诉世界模型该记住什么」的新接口，但当前验证停留在表征层面。

reported_papers.title: Play2Perfect: What Matters in Dexterous Play Pretraining for Precise Assembly?
reported_papers.reason: 系统消融多指灵巧手「玩耍式」预训练对精密装配任务的影响因素，回应接触丰富任务数据难采集的问题。属灵巧操作数据侧的实证研究，对做多指 VLA 的团队有经验参考，但非 VLA 架构贡献。

reported_papers.title: RAP-WAM: Learning World-Action Models through Predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations
reported_papers.reason: 把预测性演练与动作扰动结合，解决视频生成先验如何有效指导策略学习的问题，属 world-action model 训练方法。方向与 VLA 规划侧高度相关，但摘要未给出基准对比，暂按值得了解处理。

reported_papers.title: T2-z: Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents for Robotic World Models
reported_papers.reason: 在测试时在线优化环境隐变量，补偿摩擦、质量、人类干扰等不可观测因素，提升机器人世界模型的动作后果预测。与世界模型驱动的策略规划互补，但当前贡献集中在前向预测精度。

reported_papers.title: GeoState: Learning View-Decoupled Geometry States for 3D World Modeling
reported_papers.reason: 针对几何基础模型特征的视角依赖问题，把场景动力学与相机引起的表观变化解耦，得到视角无关的 3D 世界状态。对具身世界模型的表征质量有提升，但未验证于机器人操作策略。

reported_papers.title: Whole-Body Dexterity
reported_papers.reason: 主张人形灵巧操作不应局限于末端执行器，提出用前臂与躯干支撑、滑动大体积物体的全身操作范式。切中灵巧操作瓶颈，但摘要未给出策略架构与实验量化，需读正文才能判断可复用性。

reported_papers.title: CoWorld Reasoner: Agentic Multimodal Reasoning with the Evolving Video World Model-Driven Harness
reported_papers.reason: 用视频世界模型作为统一引擎，驱动 agent 对运动、动作与视角变化做时空推理，超越输入帧可见内容。属通用多模态 agent 推理框架，未涉及机器人操作闭环，暂不构成 VLA 可复用组件。

reported_papers.title: Learning Intrinsic Dynamics in Latent World Models
reported_papers.reason: 指出与动作无关的视觉变化会污染潜空间中的动作-后果关系，提出分离内在动力学的表征学习目标。对世界模型/视频预测有方法论价值，但验证偏仿真，未接入真实机器人策略。

reported_papers.title: Evaluating Multimodal LLMs as Generalist Vision-Language-Action Agents for Drone Control: Commanding, Approaching, Tracking and Searching
reported_papers.reason: 把多模态 LLM 当作无人机通用 agent，在真实多机、目标可移动的场景下评测指令解析、接近、跟踪与搜索四类能力，突破以往纯仿真单机评测。属空中具身 agent 评测，与机械臂操作 VLA 的关键技术不可直接复用。

reported_papers.title: EmbodiedMidtrain: Bridging the Gap between Vision-Language Models and Vision-Language-Action Models via Mid-training
reported_papers.reason: 提出在通用 VLM 与 VLA 后训练之间插入 embodied mid-training 阶段，用具身数据把视觉-语言表征对齐到机器人域，再下接动作学习。给出了训练阶段划分与数据配比的可复现范式，可直接用于改造现有 VLM 底座。

reported_papers.title: LIBERO-Industry: Benchmarking Robotic Manipulation under Industrial Process Constraints
reported_papers.reason: 针对高混合低产量电子装配场景，把工艺顺序、公差等工业过程约束纳入操作 benchmark，弥补 LIBERO 系列缺少过程约束的空白。属评测基础设施，对有工业落地需求的团队有用但不紧急。

reported_papers.title: Memory as Weights: Internalizing Long-Term History for Streaming Videos
reported_papers.reason: 将长期历史内化进模型权重而非压缩/检索/缓存，使流式 VLM 在保持实时响应的同时累积过去信息。属长视频理解侧的记忆机制创新，未涉及机器人操作或具身决策，仅可作为 VLA 记忆设计的远距离参考。

reported_papers.title: Large-scale iontronic skins with neural-hierarchical processing architecture
reported_papers.reason: 提出高密度离子电子皮肤阵列配神经分层处理架构，把快速读出与数据压缩前置到传感端，实现人形机器人精细纹理感知与轻柔操作。属触觉硬件与信号处理层，尚未接入 VLA 策略训练，但为触觉 VLA 提供上游感知基础。

reported_papers.title: Test-Time Compute for Humanoid Behavior Foundation Models
reported_papers.reason: 提出测试时命令优化 TTCO：保持人形 BFM 权重不变，利用闭环仿真采样优化输入命令。摘要报告，在 AMASS 的三个 BFM 仿真实验中，全局体位误差降低 79–84%；也可从已记录的机器人轨迹生成 BFM 专属动作标签，供高层 loco-manipulation 策略训练。摘要包含仿真与真机实验，但未说明所有标签来源轨迹均为真机数据；这里未独立复现实验。

reported_papers.title: REMM: Revisable Embodied Memory for Manipulation

reported_papers.title: StereoEngine: Scaling Stereo Bimanual Robot Data without Stereo Cameras

reported_papers.title: Tactile Sensing-based Secure and Gentle Grasping of Unknown Objects
reported_papers.reason: 基于触觉的在线数据驱动预测控制，同时保证抓牢与不损伤未知物体；属纯抓取控制，未涉及 VLA 训练或架构。

reported_papers.title: Gamma: Grounded Multi-Agent Memory with Mechanical Audit for Memory-Intensive Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 给预训练 VLA 加 grounded 多智能体记忆与机械审计模块，解决依赖远期事件的记忆型操作；但记忆方向已有 REMM/PMTRM 等多篇，增量有限。

reported_papers.title: EC-EarthFlow: Probabilistic emulation of daily transient global climate model simulations with flow matching
reported_papers.reason: 用流匹配概率模拟全球气候模式日尺度温度场，属气候科学应用，与机器人操作无关。

reported_papers.title: Conditional Flow Matching for Generation of 3D Multi-variable Instantaneous Urban Microclimate Fields
reported_papers.reason: 用条件流匹配生成城市微气候瞬时三维场，属城市气候建模，与机器人操作无关。

reported_papers.title: MeshCarve: Artisan Mesh Generation with Flow Matching in Compact Latent Spaces
reported_papers.reason: 面向工艺网格生成的流匹配方法，属 3D 生成任务，与机器人操作无关。

reported_papers.title: Explicit Geometric Chain-of-Thought for Vision-Language-Action in Autonomous Driving
reported_papers.reason: 面向自动驾驶的 VLA 几何思维链方法，属自动驾驶领域，非机器人操作。

reported_papers.reason: 面向 MLLM 交错图文生成的自我校正优化，属纯多模态生成任务，与机器人操作及 VLA 无关。

reported_papers.title: Velocity Scaling in Flow Matching
reported_papers.reason: 重新分析流匹配中速度场缩放改进生成质量的原因，纠正此前 MSE 系统性低估速度幅度的解释。属流匹配生成理论，可影响扩散/流策略的采样质量分析。

reported_papers.title: SearchWorld: Spatial Value-Grounded Imagination for UAV Object Search via World Models
reported_papers.reason: 面向无人机城市目标搜索的世界模型与空间价值想象，属 UAV 导航搜索，与机器人操作 VLA 无实质关联。

reported_papers.title: EmbodiedRSI: Active Continual Robot Learning Through Hypothesis-Guided Co-Evolution
reported_papers.reason: 针对机器人基础模型在物体位置/指令变化时性能退化、后训练数据昂贵的问题，提出假设引导的主动持续学习与共演化。属 agentic 自改进方向探索。

reported_papers.title: MemoWM: How World Models Change What Agents Need to Remember
reported_papers.reason: 研究在世界模型条件下 agent 记忆分配问题，利用世界模型捕获的可复用规律减少每段经验的存储需求。属长程 agent 记忆方向，与 VLA 无直接接口。

reported_papers.title: RoboRender: Robot-Oriented Video Generation for Visual Sim-to-Real Transfer
reported_papers.reason: 用面向机器人的视频生成弥合仿真与真实的视觉差异，避免中间表征丢失语义，实现视觉 sim-to-real 迁移。可作仿真数据增广的生成式方案参考。

reported_papers.title: LeCuration: A Tiny World Model as a Data Curation Multi-Tool
reported_papers.reason: 面向封闭物理世界的物理 AI 应用，用微型世界模型做数据组织、过滤与策展。属数据策展方向，可作机器人数据清洗参考。

reported_papers.title: Co${}^{2}$Skill: Whole-Body Control via Skill Composition for Long-Horizon Human-Environment Interaction
reported_papers.reason: 用技能组合统一全身场景交互与灵巧物体操作，实现长程人-环境物理交互控制。属物理仿真全身控制方向，与 VLA 策略学习无直接接口。

reported_papers.title: Predicted Futures Are Not Enough: Learning Executable Goals for Robot Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 指出生成式世界模型预测的未来不直接暴露控制所需的任务变量，提出学习可执行目标变量而非仅监督未来预测。对世界模型到控制接口设计有启发。

reported_papers.title: Immiscible Diffusion Policy: Preserving Multimodal Robot Actions through Label-Free Noise Assignment
reported_papers.reason: 发现扩散策略常坍缩到单一动作模态，提出无标签噪声分配的不可混溶扩散策略以保留多模态动作分布。对扩散策略多模态建模有直接参考价值。

reported_papers.title: TempoBridge: Language-Guided Tempo Control for Vision-Language-Action Policies
reported_papers.reason: 针对 VLA 能理解做什么但难以控制怎么做（快慢节奏）的问题，用冻结 VLA 表征轻量调制动作实现语言引导的节奏控制。可作 VLA 执行时序控制参考。

reported_papers.title: RobotAPO: Adversarial Physics Preference Optimization for Robotic Manipulation Video Generation
reported_papers.reason: 指出纯视觉逼真的操作视频生成常违反物理（如互穿），提出对抗式物理偏好优化让生成的视觉规划更符合物理流形。属操作视频生成方向，与策略控制无直接接口。

reported_papers.title: RLHND: Video Foundation Models as Physically Grounded Hand Trackers for Robot Learning
reported_papers.reason: 把视频基础模型用作物理接地的手部跟踪器，从人手视频中提取更准确、物理一致的手部运动以训练机器人策略。对利用人手视频的机器人学习数据管线有价值。

reported_papers.title: TMT: Runtime Backdoor Detection for Vision-Language-Action Policies on Unseen Tasks
reported_papers.reason: 针对后门 VLA 策略在触发条件下产生恶意动作、且恶意行为单步看似合理而难以检测的问题，提出运行时后门检测。属 VLA 安全方向，场景较专门。

reported_papers.title: Precise SE(3) End-Effector Tracking in Whole-Body Humanoid Control
reported_papers.reason: 提出 ResGAC 全身人形控制器，结合几何导纳实现浮动基扰动下的精确末端 SE(3) 位姿跟踪。属人形全身控制，与操作型 VLA 关系较远。

reported_papers.title: Sparse Feature Policy Unlearning Mitigates State Hallucination in Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_papers.reason: 研究 VLA 的状态幻觉（不可靠行为）问题，用稀疏特征策略遗忘来缓解。属 VLA 可靠性/纠错方向，可作安全部署参考。

reported_papers.title: TERRA: Learning Transportable Latent Actions through Temporal Effect Representation and Relational Alignment
reported_papers.reason: 研究隐动作从视觉转移中学到的编码应保留什么、以及跨初始状态复用时语义是否一致这两个核心问题，提出时序效应表征与关系对齐。对隐动作表征设计有参考价值。

reported_papers.title: Contact-Aware Imitation Learning Through Contact Factorization
reported_papers.reason: 将接触条件分解，使接触丰富操作策略在表面几何、朝向与摩擦变化时保持任务行为、适配物理实现。对接触丰富策略的泛化设计有启发。

reported_papers.title: MagCilia: A Compact Magnetociliary Tactile Sensor with 3D Force Sensing for Robotic Contact Perception and Grasping Feedback
reported_papers.reason: 提出结合柔性磁纤毛与霍尔传感的紧凑触觉传感器，可同时测法向与切向力并感知表面信息。属触觉硬件设计，可作抓取反馈传感选型参考。

reported_papers.title: Targeted Modality Dropout for Real-Robot Manipulation Robust to Intermittent Vision Loss
reported_papers.reason: 针对多模态模仿学习过度依赖视觉、推理时视觉丢失即失效的问题，提出定向模态丢弃提升间歇视觉丢失下的鲁棒性。属多模态融合训练技巧，可复用。

reported_papers.title: RoboPace: Contact-Aware Time-Optimal Retiming for Action-Chunk Policies
reported_papers.reason: 指出 UMI/人手示教数据会让 VLA 继承演示者的执行节奏，提出接触感知的时间最优重定时代替简单时间缩放。对动作块策略的执行速度优化有参考价值。

reported_papers.title: YUBI-STAG: Contact and Semantic-Rich Alignment for VLAs via Automated Video-Language Grounding
reported_papers.reason: 针对机器人示教仅含粗粒度任务描述的问题，用自动化视频-语言接地为 VLA 提供接触与语义丰富的细粒度指令对齐。可作 VLA 指令数据自动标注参考。

reported_papers.title: UltraWorld: Learning Interactive Ultrasound World Models from Untracked Clinical Videos with Acoustic Sampling Map
reported_papers.reason: 从无位姿标注的临床超声视频学习交互式超声世界模型以支持自主扫描，属医疗影像应用，与通用机器人操作 VLA 无关。

reported_papers.title: Towards Accurate End-Effector Localization for UMI-Style Robotic Manipulation Teaching
reported_papers.reason: 针对 UMI 式手持示教中近距离遮挡下的末端定位精度问题，构建操作场景的定位评测基准并改进方法。对 UMI 数据采集管线有工程价值。

reported_papers.title: Juno: Taming Predictive Latents for Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_papers.reason: 将 JEPA 式联合嵌入预测架构的预测隐变量引入 VLA，统一预训练、策略学习与部署三阶段的隐表征使用。为 VLA 引入预测式表征提供可复用的训练范式。

reported_papers.title: Many Ways to Succeed: Diversity-Driven RL Fine-Tuning for VLA Generalization
reported_papers.reason: 分析 RL 微调会全局收缩探索仅在成功区多样化的现象，提出多样性驱动的 RL 微调提升 VLA 在微调分布外的泛化。做 VLA RL 精调可直接借鉴其探索重塑策略。

reported_papers.title: Tactile Reconstruction of Contact Task Frames and Forces for Hybrid Force/Motion Control
reported_papers.reason: 仅凭触觉估计接触任务坐标系与交互力，为混合力/位控制提供力控方向与力大小，免去力矩传感与标称环境模型。属触觉-控制结合，可作力控接口参考。

reported_papers.title: TacHair: Tactile Contact-Distribution Guided Online Correction for Robotic Hair Stroking and Perception
reported_papers.reason: 用触觉接触分布引导机器人梳发与感知的在线纠偏，替代纯轨迹规划与力调节方法。属特定护理场景的触觉应用，通用性有限。

reported_papers.title: Do Vision-Language-Action Models Understand Instructions? A Mechanistic Interpretability Study on Language Grounding
reported_papers.reason: 用机制可解释性方法检验 VLA 的动作生成是否真正依赖语言指令，还是主要依赖视觉线索与表面相关性。为 VLA 语言接地分析提供工具视角。

reported_papers.title: Temporal Visuo-Tactile Learning for Dexterous Grasp Stability
reported_papers.reason: 系统研究高分辨率动态触觉如何结合视觉提升灵巧抓取稳定性，强调指尖时序触觉反馈的作用。对触觉抓取策略的传感器与特征选择有参考价值。

reported_papers.title: Hall Effect-Based Tactile Force Detection Sensor for Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Surgery
reported_papers.reason: 面向微创手术机器人的霍尔特效应触觉力传感器硬件设计，属医疗手术器械传感，与 VLA 及通用机器人操作无关。

reported_papers.title: Temporally Interpretable Differentiable Decision Trees

reported_papers.title: OpenViTac: Learning and Benchmarking Visuo-Tactile Policies in a Unified Sim-and-Real Framework
reported_papers.reason: 提出统一的仿真-真实框架，用于学习并基准评测视触觉-语言-动作（VTLA）策略，填补触觉 VLA 缺少统一评测基准的空白。做触觉操作可直接采用其评测与训练流程。

reported_papers.title: RoboQuest: Generalist Physical Agents that Search, Inspect and Test
reported_papers.reason: 让多模态基础模型作为通用物理智能体，在陌生环境中主动搜索、检查与测试缺失的任务相关信息。属 agentic 操作方向探索，偏概念验证。

reported_papers.title: Q-Learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching

reported_papers.title: LLA-MPPI: Rapidly Adaptive Whole-body Control of Legged Robots with GPU-Accelerated Parallel Simulations
reported_papers.reason: 面向足式机器人全身控制的快速自适应 MPPI 控制器，属腿式运动控制，与机器人操作及 VLA 无实质关联。

reported_papers.title: Agentic RSR: Real-to-Sim-to-Real through Scene Reconstruction and Execution-Grounded Robot Policies
reported_papers.reason: 将真实工作区的场景重建与策略开发统一为 agentic 的 real-to-sim-to-real 流程，保证仿真保真度与真实可观测性一致。属仿真迁移工程框架，可作数据生成管线参考。

reported_papers.title: Factorized Tactile Representation and Control for Sim-to-Real Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 提出因子化触觉表征与控制框架，将法向力与接触斑映射为可恢复的有效接触响应，桥接仿真接触与实机传感器差异。对触觉 sim-to-real 表征设计有参考价值。

reported_papers.title: RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models
reported_papers.reason: 系统研究机器人隐世界模型随模型规模、数据与算力的扩展规律，给出可预测能力增长的原则性方法。为世界模型方向的规模化研究提供方法论参考。

reported_papers.title: Rephrase Before You Act: Characterizing and Mitigating Language Sensitivity in Vision-Language-Action Models

reported_papers.title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models

reported_papers.title: RoboPrompt: Intuitive Robot Policy Steering with Sparse Human Input
reported_papers.reason: 用稀疏人类输入引导端到端模仿学习策略，免去共享自治中笨重的遥操作硬件与操作员训练。属人类在环策略纠偏，可作交互式数据采集参考。

reported_papers.title: TAPNAV: Humanoid Navigation through Tactile Active Perception
reported_papers.reason: 面向视觉受限环境的人形导航，用触觉主动探测缓解里程计漂移与定位不确定。触觉用于导航而非操作，与触觉操作 VLA 方向不同。

reported_papers.title: NavGPT-3: Harnessing Context in a Hierarchical Navigation Runtime
reported_papers.reason: 用长程 agentic RL 训练的 LM 构建分层导航运行时，在具身导航中利用上下文进行推理与决策。属导航方向，与操作型 VLA 关系较远。

reported_papers.title: Diagnosing and Recovering from Observation-Space Shift at Long-Horizon Skill Seams
reported_papers.reason: 诊断长程任务串联独立技能时，下游技能观测分布偏离训练分布（skill seam）导致的性能骤降，并提出恢复方法。对长程组合策略的部署有启发。

reported_papers.title: Cross-Embodiment Robot Foundation World Models with Latent Actions
reported_papers.reason: 提出 LAC-WM，在跨形态共享的隐动作空间内学习机器人世界模型，解决不同本体与动作空间难以统一建模的问题。为跨形态世界模型与隐动作表征提供思路。

reported_papers.title: OmniHOI: Dexterous Hand-Object Interaction from Monocular Human Video

reported_papers.title: Self-Supervised Keyframe Discovery for Horizon-Invariant Behavior Cloning
reported_papers.reason: 针对非马尔可夫长程环境下的行为克隆，用自监督关键帧发现替代循环/注意力长程建模，缓解对上下文长度依赖。属 BC 架构改进，可作长程策略设计参考。

reported_papers.title: Informationally Decoupled Trajectory Design for Sim-to-Real System Identification
reported_papers.reason: 针对采样式系统辨识中轨迹难以区分不同参数效应的问题，提出信息解耦的轨迹设计以提升 sim-to-real 参数辨识精度。属仿真迁移底层方法，与 VLA 策略训练无直接接口。

reported_papers.title: When Listening Becomes Easier: Scrubbing Visual Cues for Shortcut-Free VLAs
